required_audit_coverage.name: required_audit_coverage
required_audit_coverage.detail: report covers all 30 Required Audit items with substantive aligned answers
required_audit_items: Is decision_meta valid JSON and schema_version=1?
Is status APPROVED?
Is mainline engineering_branch?
Is reverse-agent-iteration@v2 active?
Is task_packet treated as advisory/background only?
Was the previous failed round correctly identified as decision_20260708_user_solve_contract_foundation_v1?
Did the rework avoid expanding User Solve functionality beyond coverage repair and direct test failures?
Does command_plan.json include an explicit pytest command?
Does command_plan.json pytest command include tests/test_user_solve_contract.py?
Does command_plan.json pytest command include tests/test_user_solve_state.py?
Does command_plan.json pytest command include tests/test_user_solve_errors.py?
Does command_plan.json pytest command include tests/test_user_solve_views.py when user_solve_views.py exists or is changed?
Does pytest_result.txt summary include the same User Solve pytest command?
Does pytest_result.txt transcript show the same User Solve pytest command with exit code 0?
Does codex_execution_report.md tests_ran include the User Solve pytest command?
Does execution_report.md tests_ran include the User Solve pytest command?
Does final-check explicitly validate that changed tests are covered by pytest_result?
Does final-check block if tests/test_user_solve_* are changed but omitted from pytest?
Do UserSolveResult tests still verify candidate_found != verified?
Do User Solve tests still verify static_verified != runtime_validated?
Do User Solve tests still verify runtime_validated requires runtime evidence?
Do User Solve tests still verify failed/blocked require explicit reason?
Were any omitted or unauthorized commands executed?
Were project_state/current_state.json and task_packet.json left untouched?
Were artifact_index, negative_results, state_manifest, context, roadmap, domains, frontend, workflows, solve_reports, and training materials left untouched?
Did final-check pass or accurately reflect any limitations?
Did run-closeout pass?
Did close-round generate round_manifest for round_20260708_user_solve_contract_test_coverage_rework_v1?
Do execution_report.md and codex_execution_report.md agree on decision_id, round_id, status, acceptance_recommendation, tests_ran, and generated_artifacts?
Does round_manifest status agree with live reports and final_gate status_summary?
